
```{r calculate ptau categories}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr params$kuadrc_blood
#| results: asis
fq("UNDERSTANDING YOUR ALZHEIMER'S DISEASE RISK", type = "section")

analytevars <- c("analyte", "assay_used", "analyte_value")


analytes <- db(!!!analytevars, date = "fluid_collection_date", data = data)

ptau <-
  db(ptau217_pgml, date = "ptau217_date", data = data) |>
  # fmt: skip
  dplyr::rename(fluid_collection_date = ptau217_date, analyte_value = ptau217_pgml) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    analyte = "ptau217_pgml",
    assay_used = dplyr::case_when(
      analyte_value >= 0.1 ~ "pTau217_simoa",
      analyte_value < 0.1 ~ "pTau217_lumipulse"
    )
  )

ptau <- dplyr::left_join(
  ptau,
  dplyr::filter(analytes, analyte == "ptau217_pgml"),
  by = c("fluid_collection_date", "analyte", "assay_used", "analyte_value")
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    assay_used = factor(
      assay_used,
      levels = c("pTau217_simoa", "pTau217_lumipulse"),
      labels = c("pTau217", "pTau217/A\u03B242")
    )
  )

if (nrow(ptau) == 0) {
  params$kuadrc_ptau217 <- FALSE
}

karyotype <- db(dschrom, date = date, data = data)

karyotype <- karyotype[karyotype$dschrom != 9, ]

if (nrow(karyotype) == 0) {
  params$kuadrc_karyotype <- FALSE
}
```
